self_target.text: A coordinated surprise community feast or gathering in the town hall at eighteen, with lanterns and two hundred fresh loaves. Builder coordinates supplies and lighting, innkeeper supplies bread and escorts the mayor, and neighbour spreads invitations. Secretary knowingly assists with escort scheduling, though apparently does not know the occasion's details. The precise occasion remains deliberately withheld from the mayor; baker involvement in the preparations is not verified.

A coordinated community supper and service acknowledgement in the great hall at eighteen, presented to me as a lighting inspection. Builder is organising access and arranging my escort; innkeeper is bringing bread, with baker and freight coordinating delivery. Neighbour knowingly collects donations and escorts me while leaving acknowledgement details to organisers; secretary maintains the inspection appointment and will accompany me. The precise acknowledgement and its recipient remain undisclosed, possibly a surprise for me.

Possibly a gathering or work near the bridge or port involving supplies, bread and lights. The builder sought the innkeeper about supplies, the baker was reported carrying a sack of bread at the inn, and the neighbour heard vague talk of lights and changes near the bridge or port. These are circumstantial links only; no joint plan, purpose, or knowing helpers have been confirmed.

The innkeeper, builder and freight are jointly preparing an evening great-hall gathering with a substantial reserved bread supply, under the name hospitality committee. Its actual occasion and guests have not been disclosed to me; explanations are deferred until eighteen hundred and I have been asked not to arrive early. The baker apparently supports the bread provision, while the secretary knowingly helps arrange my attendance and timing, but neither is established to know the undisclosed purpose.

Likely a surprise communal gathering or celebration for the mayor in the great hall, with the eighteen hundred lighting inspection serving as a reason to bring the mayor there. The precise occasion and each person's knowledge are not confirmed; the secretary's and neighbour's involvement is inferred rather than directly witnessed.

The precise purpose is unknown; the bridge/port rumour is unconfirmed, and the lighting inspection could also be genuine.

Exact occasion and builder/freight roles remain unconfirmed; secretary may only be helping arrange the appointment without knowing its purpose.

Builder installed eight lanterns and innkeeper is ensuring my attendance and offering to escort me. Baker supplies bread and knows about the debt, though whether baker knows the full plan is uncertain. No clear evidence secretary or neighbour knowingly participates in the concealed preparations.
